text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ohh… Oww… Uugh, I think a headache is coming on…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: My head suddenly hurts… I don't think it's because of a cold…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I haven't tripped yet today, either… What could be the reason? Nghh…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Owie! Ow ow! It's starting to hurt again…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: That's true… I do feel like too much thinking sometimes gives me a headache.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Which means… maybe I should stop thinking altogether? O-okay, no more thinking. Don't think.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ohhh… But I can't finish the day without reflecting on my actions!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ow! Ow ow ow! I'm not sure if I can stop thinking…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unable to stop her ruminating, Meisho Doto agonizes over her headache.
